lesson.title: Exploring the Observer Effect
lesson.topic: Understanding how observation can alter what is being observed, from quantum physics to human behavior.
lesson.steelman: How might the observer effect be leveraged for personal development and scientific inquiry?
lesson.example: The influence of medical staff on patient recovery rates when they are informed about a new treatment's efficacy.

rationale: Adding this lesson helps students understand the profound implications of observer effects across various fields.
